_doc: What the hotel's rules cost in Wybe's sim (round 5, domain reviews). Hotel-rules mode on side branch hamad/hotelrules at 70d5be4 (NS_HOTEL_RULES=1; default off, byte-identical): knock before every keycard entry, never move a sign off a wet floor, avoid known-wet corridors, sign an unreported patch after a slip. Live: four practice nights started 05:49 Sun 8 Nov, measured complete at ~05:55 on seeds 10/16/23/5 (ledger.csv rows of commit 70d5be4); the final build's nights on the same seeds are c3801e0's (013f90d, the same agent as 8de9ffc, scored 1 point lower on seed 10). Keycard entries and knocks counted with masterKeyEntries (conduct.ts) over the eight logs. Replay: the replay bed on 164 real nights, as reported by the controller.
_doc_rules2: rules2: hotel rules 5 and 6 on hamad/hotelrules at 41b10f4 (NS_HOTEL_RULES=1; default off, never in the final build), replayed on the replay bed's frozen 202 real nights / 30 seeds (docs/runs/hotel-rules-replay-2.md, copied from that checkout's temp/hotelrules-report-2.md). Points are the mean delta per night against the same nights without the rules, plain and seed-weighted (each seed's mean, then the mean of those). selfConflict: the room check names the bags the robot itself carried in instead of reporting the room empty, outcome kept 'done' (live: the simulator thanked 389 of 390 such checks, about 38 points each, so reporting them failed would cost about 70 a night, an estimate, not replayed). homeBy0545: the master keycard returned and the robot docked by 05:45.
